title: I Reincarnated as the Villainous Noble Destined to Be Destroyed by the Trash Hero Party, but I'll Crush Them Completely with My Knowledge of the Original Story and Hard Work.
description: Reincarnated as Blado, a villainous noble in the massive game Hero War, a veteran player faces a gruesome fate: execution by the corrupt “heroic” party. To rewrite his destiny, he trains ruthlessly for a year under two legendary hidden figures—a former elite swordswoman and an archmage, now working as his mansion’s staff. Armed with supreme power and deep game knowledge, Blado enters the academy, crushing every foe.
author: none
